changes: Sign-in works again: accounts now run on a hosted server that keeps your data across restarts.
Nothing needs your PC to stay on any more.
The app finds a working server by itself if one ever goes down.
New source: HentaiHaven (18+), with its own icon and English subtitles.
Changed how the app talks to the server, so a cold server no longer looks offline.
Moved off Fly.io to a free host, so the server stays up while your PC is off.
The app finds the server again by itself if its address ever changes.
Health check works without the API token, for uptime pings.
